newsitem.title: USA: Somatogen adopts preferred rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Somatogen adopts preferred rights plan.

text.p: Somatogen Inc said Wednesday its board has adopted a preferred share purchase rights plan giving stockholders one right to purchase one one-hundredth of a share of a new series of preferred stock for each share of common stock held at the close of business on June 12.
The rights will be distributed as a non-taxable dividend and will expire June 5, 2007.

The company said the rights will only be exercisable if a group or individual acquires at least 15 percent of the company's common stock or announces a tender offer for at least 15 percent of the company's common stock.
If a person acquires at least 15 percent of the company's stock, all rightsholders except for the buyer will be entitled to acquire company common stock at a discount, it said.
The effect will be to discourage acquisitions of more than 15 percent of common stock without first negotiating with the board, it said.
The company said the rights plan is not a response to any specific overtures towards the company.
